content: We presented a simple approach where a single multilingual NMT model is adapted to monolingual transfer and performs grammatical error correction and style transfer. We experimented with three languages and presented extensive evaluation of the model on both tasks. We used publicly available software and data and believe that our work can be easily reproduced.
